lyrics:
Long long long ago 

There lived a village girl

She was a mystery

That no one knew about

She was under a spell of witch

She could never escape from

But

She waited hard for that day to become free

She could burn this world around 

And fly like a dragon queen 

She could wash the memories 

Of all the human beings

She was under a spell of witch

She could never escape from

But

She waited hard for that day to become free
